explanation: Teatro alla Scala opened in 1778. It takes its name from the church of Santa Maria alla Scala, which stood on the site until it was pulled down to make way for the theatre.

claims.text: The opera house La Scala is in Milan.
La Scala is not in Rome, Venice or Naples.
La Scala is named after the church of Santa Maria alla Scala, which was demolished to make way for the theatre.
